payload.summary: Caring Contacts: the frozen interaction matrix's 'Recovery action only' wording is ambiguous
payload.detail: Two rows (session-expiry and version-conflict) carry the prose 'Recovery action only', which reads either as recovery-action only or as recovery, action-only. Ruling 58 kept both rows faithful to the frozen record rather than reword them. Resolve the wording when the matrix is next unfrozen, not before.
